threads.summary: A dispatched job for a Hattiesburg, MS tech got reassigned by automation to a tech in Jackson, WY, so the confirmation email went to the wrong tech.
threads.note: The v2 automation overwrite bug is already fixed by Adjet, but the underlying bad lat_long for scheduling city 'Jackson, WY - 003 - Pro3' still needs Ryan to correct it.

threads.summary: Vacasa jobs in Ocean City, MD were showing unexpectedly low Total Travel Distance values, suggesting no Vacasa In-Network city was being matched nearby.
